```{r, message=F}
library (tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(iNEXT)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
MOTUs <-  read_csv("Data/trap_MOTUs.csv") %>%
  mutate(Date = dmy(Date))
```

# Finding number of MOTUs on each day

```{r}
motus_to_keep <- MOTUs %>%
  count(Trap, MOTU, name = "Total") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Trap, values_from = Total, values_fill = 0) %>%
  filter(T1 >= 5, T3 >= 5) %>%
  pull(MOTU)

MOTUs_filtered <- MOTUs %>%
  filter(MOTU %in% motus_to_keep)


motu_counts <- MOTUs_filtered %>%
  count(Trap, Date, MOTU, name = "Count")

motu_matrix <- motu_counts %>%
  arrange(Trap, Date) %>%                  # chronological within each trap
  mutate(Trap_Date = paste(Trap, format(Date, "%Y-%m-%d"), sep = "_")) %>%
  select(MOTU, Trap_Date, Count) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Trap_Date,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(MOTU)

motu_matrix
```



```{r}
# Creates a column of just pollinator MOTUs with NA for non-pollinators
MOTUs$pols <- ifelse(MOTUs$MOTU %in% c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 17, 51, 52), MOTUs$MOTU, NA)

# Creates same but with nonpollinators
MOTUs$nonpol <- ifelse(!MOTUs$MOTU %in% c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 17, 51, 52), MOTUs$MOTU, NA)
```

## Running Chi-squared between number of pollinators in each trap
```{r}
   MOTUs$is_pol <- MOTUs$MOTU %in% c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 17, 51, 52)
   tab <- table(MOTUs$Trap, MOTUs$is_pol)
   tab
   fisher.test(tab)
```

## Running Chi-squared to compare MOTU distributions
```{r}
# By trap X MOTU
pols_bytrap <- table(MOTUs$pols, MOTUs$Trap)
nonpols_bytrap <- table(MOTUs$nonpol, MOTUs$Trap)
pols_bytrap
nonpols_bytrap
```

```{r}
# Running Fisher Tests:
fisher.test(pols_bytrap, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
chisq.test(pols_bytrap, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)

fisher.test(nonpols_bytrap, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
chisq.test(nonpols_bytrap, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
```
```{r}
# By Date X MOTU
pols_bydate <- table(MOTUs$pols, MOTUs$Date)
nonpols_bydate <- table(MOTUs$nonpol, MOTUs$Date)
pols_bydate
nonpols_bydate
```

```{r}
# Running fisher tests
fisher.test(pols_bydate, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
chisq.test(pols_bydate, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)

fisher.test(nonpols_bydate, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
chisq.test(nonpols_bydate, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
```

```{r}

estimateR(motu_matrix)
```

The Chao1 MOTU estimate is 64 (10.99 SE)

```{r}
# Calculating shannon and simpson diversity index

simp_ind <- diversity(motu_matrix, index = "simpson")
```

# Creating rarefaction curve

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(iNEXT)
library(ggplot2)
```
```{r}
# ---- Data ----
dat <- read_csv("Data/trap_MOTUs.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
x <- dat |> count(MOTU, name = "total") |> arrange(desc(total)) |> pull(total)

n_end <- 2 * sum(x)   # 954 = 2 x observed sample size

# ---- iNEXT: extrapolate to exactly 2x the sample size ----
out <- iNEXT(x, q = c(0, 1, 2), datatype = "abundance",
             endpoint = n_end, nboot = 200)

```

```{r}
out$AsyEst
```

```{r}
p <- ggiNEXT(out, type = 1, facet.var = "None", color.var = "Order.q") +
  facet_wrap(~ Order.q,
             labeller = as_labeller(c("0" = "Species richness",
                                      "1" = "Shannon Hill",
                                      "2" = "Simpson Hill"))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#D95F02", "#2C7BB6", "#7B3294")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D95F02", "#2C7BB6", "#7B3294")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 250, 500, 750, n_end)) +
  labs(x = "Number of individuals", y = "Species diversity") +
  theme_grey(base_size = 18) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        aspect.ratio = 1.1,                 # panel height / width
        panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 20, 5, 5))

p
```

# Trap level sex bias

```{r}
female <- read_csv("Data/trap_female_proportion.csv")
```



```{r}
# Makes dates as date format and makes trap a factor
female <- read_csv("Data/trap_female_proportion.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    date  = dmy(date),
    trap  = factor(trap),
    total = n_female + n_male,
    
    # 95% Wilson CIs for each trap x date proportion
    ci    = map2(n_female, total, ~ prop.test(.x, .y, correct = FALSE)$conf.int),
    lower = map_dbl(ci, 1),
    upper = map_dbl(ci, 2)
  )
```

```{r}
# T1 vs T3 within each date: Fisher's exact test, Holm-adjusted
tests <- female %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    p    = fisher.test(matrix(c(n_female, n_male), ncol = 2))$p.value,
    ymax = max(upper),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"),
    stars = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    ),
    x       = as.numeric(factor(date)),  # position on the discrete x axis
    bracket = ymax + 0.04
  )

```

```{r}
ggplot(female, aes(x = factor(date), y = prop_female, fill = trap)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
  # significance brackets and stars
  geom_segment(data = tests, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = x - 0.2, xend = x + 0.2, y = bracket, yend = bracket)) +
  geom_text(data = tests, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = x, y = bracket, label = stars),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 5) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) format(as.Date(x), "%d %b %Y")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("T1" = "#2C7BB6", "T3" = "#D95F02")) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Proportion of female phorids",
    fill = "Trap",
    caption = "Error bars: 95% Wilson CIs. Stars: Fisher's exact test, T1 vs T3, Holm-adjusted.\n** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001, ns = not significant."
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

# Comparison of proportion of pollinating phorids between T1 and T3 over time

```{r}
library(binom)
```

```{r}
dat <- read_csv("Data/trap_MOTUs.csv")
```

```{r}
# Pollinator reference list (drop the blank column)
pollinator_ids <- dat$pollinator_MOTUs |> na.omit() |> unique()

obs <- dat |>
  select(Trap, Date, MOTU) |>
  mutate(
    Date = factor(dmy(Date),
                  levels = sort(unique(dmy(Date))),
                  labels = format(sort(unique(dmy(Date))), "%d %b %Y")),
    Trap = factor(Trap),
    pollinator = MOTU %in% pollinator_ids
  )
```

```{r}
# ---- 2. Proportions with 95% Wilson CIs ----
summ <- obs |>
  group_by(Date, Trap) |>
  summarise(n_poll = sum(pollinator), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    prop  = n_poll / n,
    lower = binom.wilson(n_poll, n)$lower,
    upper = binom.wilson(n_poll, n)$upper
  )
print(summ)
```

```{r}
trap_tests <- obs |>
  group_by(Date) |>
  summarise(p = fisher.test(table(Trap, pollinator))$p.value, .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"),
         label = case_when(p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                           p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
                           p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
                           TRUE ~ "ns"))
print(trap_tests)
```

```{r}
brackets <- summ |>
  group_by(Date) |>
  summarise(y = max(upper) + 0.05, .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(trap_tests, by = "Date") |>
  mutate(xnum = as.numeric(Date),
         xmin = xnum - 0.225, xmax = xnum + 0.225)

p <- ggplot(summ, aes(Date, prop, fill = Trap)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.85) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y)) +
  geom_text(data = brackets, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = xnum, y = y + 0.03, label = label), size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(T1 = "#2C7BB6", T3 = "#D95F02")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
labs(x = "Date",
     y = "Proportion of phorids that\nare in pollinating MOTUs",
     caption = paste0("Error bars: 95% Wilson CIs. Stars: Fisher's exact test, ",
                      "T1 vs T3, Holm-adjusted.\n",
                      "* p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001, ns = not significant.")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10))

p
```
# Created plot of T1 flowering

```{r}
# --- Read data -------------------------------------------------------------
dat <- read_csv("Data/t1_openflowers.csv")
dat$end <- as.Date(trimws(dat$Date), format = "%d/%m/%Y")
```

```{r}
# The first record has no earlier date, so give its column a start date.
# (18 Mar matches your example image - change if needed.)
first_start <- as.Date("2026-03-18")

dat <- dat %>%
  arrange(end) %>%
  mutate(
    start = lag(end, default = first_start),
    mid   = start + (end - start) / 2
  )

```

```{r}
# --- Columns to annotate with a red arrow ----------------------------------
# (columns ending on 25 Mar, 10 Apr and 11 May = 22-25 Mar, 6-10 Apr, 4-11 May)
arrows <- dat %>%
  filter(end %in% as.Date(c("2026-03-25", "2026-04-10", "2026-05-11"))) %>%
  mutate(
    arrow_top    = open_flowers + 3,    # arrow tail (data units)
    arrow_bottom = open_flowers + 0.5   # arrow tip, just above the column
  )

# --- X-axis breaks at the edges of the columns -----------------------------
brks <- sort(unique(c(dat$start, dat$end)))

```

```{r}
# --- Plot ------------------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(dat) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = open_flowers),
            fill = "darkgreen", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = arrows,
               aes(x = mid, xend = mid, y = arrow_top, yend = arrow_bottom),
               colour = "red", linewidth = 1,
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = brks, labels = format(brks, "%d %b"),
               expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of open flowers") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
```

# MOTU abundance graph

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# ---- Read data ----
dat <- read_csv("Data/trap_MOTUs.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

pollinator_ids <- c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 17)

# ---- Total abundance of each MOTU, ordered highest to lowest ----
abund <- dat |>
  count(MOTU, name = "total") |>
  mutate(type = if_else(MOTU %in% pollinator_ids, "Pollinator", "Non-pollinator"),
         MOTU = fct_reorder(factor(MOTU), total, .desc = TRUE))

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(abund, aes(x = MOTU, y = total, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 5, label = "n = 5", hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 4)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pollinator" = "#D95F02",
                               "Non-pollinator" = "grey60")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "MOTU", y = "Total abundance (T1 + T3)", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 9))
```

# Change in MOTU over time
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

dat <- read.csv("Data/trap_MOTUs.csv")

counts <- dat %>%
  select(Trap, Date, MOTU) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) %>%
  count(MOTU, Trap, Date, name = "abundance") %>%
  complete(MOTU, Trap, Date, fill = list(abundance = 0))

keep <- counts %>%
  group_by(MOTU, Trap) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Trap, values_from = total) %>%
  filter(T1 >= 5, T3 >= 5)

motu_levels <- sort(keep$MOTU)

plot_data <- counts %>%
  filter(MOTU %in% motu_levels) %>%
  mutate(MOTU = factor(MOTU, levels = motu_levels,
                       labels = paste("MOTU", motu_levels)))

# checks: expect 54 rows, 0 missing dates, 0 missing abundances
nrow(plot_data)
sum(is.na(plot_data$Date))
sum(is.na(plot_data$abundance))
```

```{r}
ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = Date, y = abundance,
           colour = MOTU, shape = Trap, linetype = Trap,
           group = Trap)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~MOTU, nrow = 3, ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(
  values = c("#E41A1C",  # red
             "#377EB8",  # blue
             "#4DAF4A",  # green
             "#984EA3",  # purple
             "#FF7F00",  # orange
             "#B8860B",  # dark
             "#A65628",  # brown
             "#F781BF",  # pink
             "#999999"), # grey
  guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("T1" = 16, "T3" = 17)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("T1" = "solid", "T3" = "dashed")) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = sort(unique(plot_data$Date)),
               date_labels = "%d %b") +
  labs(title = "Change in MOTU abundance over time",
       x = "Collection date",
       y = "Abundance (number of individuals)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"))

ggsave("motu_abundance.png", width = 9, height = 11, dpi = 300)
```
